ref.race_name: SUPPORT TRAINING AT THE LEVIN TRACK 3YO

R:OTK:1:2026-07-30.comment: 1. SKATTEBO has looked very good this prep winning 3 of her 5 starts, and he puts himself right on the pace early on. He has another good draw, and we think he is the one to beat in this. 2. BELLES BOOM kept herself out of trouble and led all the way to score at Hawera 2 weeks ago. He is likely to adopt similar tactics in this from the pole position, and he looks set to repeat the dose. 3. CAME TRUE had cost himself a win by racing greenly in his first 3 starts before putting it all together to score an end to end win at New Plymouth last week over 1400m. The extra 200m won't bother him, and he has more to offer this year. 6. BRIDIE made up late ground when finishing second to the top pick in the same race last start, and she should again be right in the finish, especially in another small field. 4. KYANITE MAN let down impressively when scoring his maiden win here just over 2 weeks ago. There is more depth to this field, but he will be hitting the line hard. top 3 claims.

runners.name: SKATTEBO
runners.comment: Last start won by a head at Waverley July 4 over 1650m in soft going defeating Jungle Love carrying 56.5kg at $10.20. Before that tracked the speed and boxed on steadily 6th of 13 at Wanganui on June 13 over 1360m, on a slow track; 0.9 len behind Belzoni carrying 58kg at $10.80. Key runner in this line-up.

runners.name: KYANITE MAN
runners.comment: Racing well recently. Last start won by 1.5 len at this track July 10 over 1600m in the wet defeating Hollaback Girl with 58.5kg at $6. The start before that 4th of 9 at Waverley on July 4 over 1400m, on a slow track; 6 len behind Guzzler with 58.5kg at $5.30. Harder here but is among the hopes.

runners.name: BRIDIE
runners.comment: Form hard to fault. Last start 2nd in a small field at Hawera on July 11 over 1600m, in the wet; 1.2 len behind Belles Boom with 51kg at $3.60. The run before that won by a long-neck at New Plymouth Raceway June 12 over 1600m in the wet defeating Our Edwardo with 51.5kg at $6.10. Key chance and expected to run well.

runners.name: CAME TRUE
runners.comment: Racing well recently. Last start won by 0.6 len at New Plymouth Raceway July 18 over 1400m in the wet defeating Performer carrying 56kg at $6.40. The race before that held ground to the line 3rd of 9 at Waverley on July 4 over 1400m, slow going 4.5 len behind Guzzler with 56.5kg at $2.10. One of the better chances.

runners.name: STAR DONNA
runners.comment: Third race start today. At debut, ran on strongly from last on the turn; 3rd of 10 at this track on July 10 over 1200m, on heavy track; 2.25 len behind Yaldy Time with 54.5kg at $23.10. Second-up 2nd of 7 at Waverley on July 24 over 1200m, slow going 0.8 len behind Brutiful Lass with 55kg at $4.20. Solid top-three chance with a repeat of that latest performance.

runners.name: BELLES BOOM
runners.comment: Racing well recently. Most recently favourite; won by 1.2 len at Hawera July 11 over 1600m in the wet defeating Bridie carrying 57kg at $2.40. The start before that ran on from midfield; 3rd of 13 at Wanganui on June 13 over 1360m, slow going 0.5 len behind Belzoni with 55kg at $7.60. Draws well and another big run is in store.

runners.name: FLAGSHIP
runners.comment: Most recently 4th of 11 at New Plymouth Raceway on July 18 over 1400m, on rain affected going; 3.5 len behind Came True carrying 56kg at $24.50. The start before that 4th of 13 at Waverley on July 4 over 1650m, slow going 2.5 len behind No More Pennies carrying 54.5kg at $28.80. Capable of a strong showing.

G:CBG:1:2026-07-30.comment: 7. OPAWA SUGAR turned in a plain run last time when sixth at this track over 650m behind Texas Snakebite (38.58) in a Class 2/3. Was in the money prior to that. Strong form has emerged from her last run. Meets a much easier field today and will be tough to beat if on-song. 5. OPAWA RANDY goes very well this trip starting 15 times for five wins and four minors. Below best last time at Manukau (31.56) in a Class 3/4, finishing a 9 length fourth. Better suited to this distance and can measure up. 3. HOOKED ON JAZZ was below best last time finishing seventh at this track, but prior to that had been racing well including a Class 1/2 win two back at this track. Rates a winning chance on best. 4. OPAWA SELENA is a last start winner who can measure up for a minor placing.

runners.name: OPAWA RANDY
runners.comment: Last start finished 4th on July 26 over 527m at Manukau behind Portland Magnum beaten 9 lengths (31.56) in a Class 3/4. Has ability and should feature.

runners.name: HOOKED ON JAZZ
runners.comment: Was out of placings last time (26.44) at this track in a Class 3/4, finishing seventh and beaten 5.5 lengths. Fairly consistent record from the draw including a win and four minors. Great chance to atone.

runners.name: OPAWA SELENA
runners.comment: Solid performance after tracking the speed to win by a neck at Manukau over 527m (31.71) beating Go Sky in Class 1/2 on July 26. Worth following up.

runners.name: GO SKY
runners.comment: Finished second at big odds last time (31.73) over 527m at Manukau. Faces a tough assignment this time.

runners.name: OPAWA SUGAR
runners.comment: Missed the frame latest (38.58) when sixth over 650m at this track in a Class 2/3. Goes very well from the draw boasting four victories and four places from 14 starts. Looks suited and should go close.

R:OTK:2:2026-07-30.comment: 2. URENUI chased home a runaway winner at Trentham last start, and he faces an even smaller field this time. He is peaking at the right time, and he is good enough to take this out. 1. BELARDO BOY will find this easier than the Opunake Cup last week, and stepping back out to a mile on this course will suit him. He has a good draw, and will be tough to hold out in this. 5. KNOCK OFF has been back to the trials since finishing well back in Stakes grade at Whanganui 8 weeks ago. He has won his only start here and would not be a surprise winner. 6. KOSTA was very disappointing at Waverley 3 weeks ago, but he will be suited to the small field, and he can bounce straight back into the money here. 4. BENEFACTOR was not too bad in the Opunake Cup, and she will find this race more to her liking. Stick with her.

runners.name: URENUI
runners.comment: Third-up today and won third-up previously. First-up sat on the speed and boxed on steadily 4th of 7 at Wanganui on June 13 over 1360m, on a slow track; 2.25 len behind Mr Mojo Risin' carrying 54.5kg at $8.60. Second run from a spell sat on speed throughout when 2nd of 8 at Trentham on July 2 over 1500m, on heavy track; 6 len behind Bradman with 55kg at $5.40. Making headway and can break through.

runners.name: KNOCK OFF
runners.comment: Comes off a 61 day let-up. At the latest run sat behind the speed prior to fading ran second last of 11 at Wanganui in the LR WangJC AGC Training (Jackson) Stakes on May 30 over 1600m, on a slow track; 4.5 len behind Electron with 59kg at $46. The race before that sat on the speed throughout before fading to run last of 7 at Waverley on May 9 over 1400m, 6 len behind Mr Mojo Risin' with 54kg at $10.90. Better than that last effort and can make amends.

runners.name: BELARDO BOY
runners.comment: Most recently 11th of 14 at New Plymouth Raceway in the LR Opunake Cup on July 18 over 1400m, on a wet track; 8 len behind Prioress carrying 58kg at $22. The start before that 3rd of 9 at Waverley on July 4 over 1400m, on a slow track; 4 len behind Bonnard carrying 58kg at $18. Certainly worth another chance.

runners.name: BENEFACTOR
runners.comment: Last start 8th of 14 at New Plymouth Raceway in the LR Opunake Cup on July 18 over 1400m, in the wet; 5.5 len behind Prioress with 53.5kg at $34.80. Before that 4th of 8 at Trentham on July 2 over 1500m, on a wet track; 10 len behind Bradman carrying 54.5kg at $4.60. Strong contender on her best form.

runners.name: LOCH KATRINE
runners.comment: At the latest run came from midfield; 3rd of 12 at New Plymouth Raceway on July 18 over 1600m, in the wet; 2.5 len behind Jungle Love carrying 53.5kg at $11.70. The run before that 5th of 11 at Tauranga on June 27 over 1400m, on heavy track; 4 len behind Rocking carrying 56kg at $9.20. Has ability and is one of the chances.

runners.name: WHAT A CHARMA
runners.comment: Comes here off a 29-day let-up. At the latest run 2nd of 7 at Arawa Park on July 1 over 1560m, on rain affected going; 1.0 len behind Scarlet Temple with 58.5kg at $20.60. The race before that 10th of 12 at Trentham on June 10 over 1500m, on rain affected going; 9 len behind Bradman with 55kg at $42.50. Made headway last time. Top chance on his best form.

runners.name: KOSTA
runners.comment: Most recently ran last of 11 at Waverley on July 4 over 1650m, slow going 11 len behind Skattebo with 60kg at $13.90. The start before that raced right near the speed and boxed on; won by a long-neck at Trentham June 10 over 1400m in the wet defeating Komocean with 57.5kg at $5.70. Has ability and can make amends.

runners.name: CUBA STREET
runners.comment: Most recently 6th of 11 at Awapuni Synthetic on July 17 over 1700m, 4 len behind Love Janie carrying 54kg at $41.50. The run before that 7th of 11 at Trentham on July 2 over 2200m, in the wet; 23 len behind Four Square Pete carrying 66.5kg at $42.10. Likely to find this out of reach.

G:CBG:2:2026-07-30.comment: 7. FOREVER FLICKY turned in a better run last time to find a minor placing (19.20) at Manukau behind Val Jewel in a Class 2. Has the pace to be prominent. Can go on with it. 6. WOW SHE'S SLOW returned a better run last time, finishing in the money (31.75) at Manukau behind Opawa Selena in a Class 1/2. Has the early speed to give a sight. Drops back in distance but is still a winning chance. 8. WEETBIX AND MILO took the sit on the lead from an outside box but levelled up and drew clear to score (21.84) at this track in a Class 1 over 375m. The form out of her last race has been franked. Can make it two on the bounce. 3. BOOM KIWI should be thereabouts. Drops slightly in class and should strip fitter today.

runners.name: SOBER DRIVER
runners.comment: Has been out of the money of late. Could only manage fourth last time out over 527m at Manukau. Not keen this time.

runners.name: FOREVER FLICKY
runners.comment: Last start finished 3rd on July 26 over 318m at Manukau behind Val Jewel beaten 4 lengths (19.20) in a Class 2. Should be right in the finish.

runners.name: WOW SHE'S SLOW
runners.comment: Ran a better race when third behind Opawa Selena at Manukau last start over 527m (31.75). Right in the mix again.

runners.name: HOW DAIRY
runners.comment: Was out of placings last time (22.27) at this track in a Class 1/2, finishing fourth and beaten 9 lengths. Strong record off the draw with two wins and two minors from five starts. Tough field and appears tested.

runners.name: BOOM KIWI
runners.comment: Improved sharply when third behind Portland Abigail at Manukau last start over 318m (19.30). Will strip fitter and is among the hopes.

runners.name: WEETBIX AND MILO
runners.comment: Good performance to post a big 5 lengths win at this track over 375m (21.84) beating Opawa Jenny in Class 1 on July 23. Can keep things rolling.

runners.name: BIG TIME CENTRAL
runners.comment: Good effort to win last start by half a length over 318m at Manukau in a handy (19.19), beating Portland Sasha. Has to be some chance.

G:SHE:1:2026-07-30.comment: 5. PAW IROHA has been mixing form lately, hitting the frame two back before finishing sixth (23.16) at Warrnambool in a Bottom Up - Maiden. Key player on best and worth another chance. 8. POLLY GOLD is yet to break through in nine starts but has run a number of placings. Is better than last start when out of the placings, finishing fourth (22.80) at Warrnambool. Better than last start and can bounce back. 7. HARTLAND MAISIE shows ability but remains a maiden after 17 starts. Was below best last time when missed the frame finishing fifth (23.33) at this track. Will give the top chances plenty to think about. 1. FREE FREDA deserves plenty of thought at her first run at this circuit.

runners.name: HARTLAND MAISIE
runners.comment: Latest effort finished 5th on July 20 over 390m at this track behind Quantez beaten 7 lengths (23.33) in a Maiden. Leading contender.

runners.name: RANSOM
runners.comment: Needs to do more than recent efforts, the latest a eighth over 390m at this track. Has failed to show enough to come into contention.

runners.name: POLLY GOLD
runners.comment: Was out of placings last time when fourth (22.80) at Warrnambool in a Bottom Up - Maiden. Will jump from box 8 for the first time. Should have the speed for this.

runners.name: SHIMA LEXIE
runners.comment: Finished in the minors at big odds last time when third (26.10) at this track, making it two placings on end. Squeeze draw to overcome. Has ability and should run well.

runners.name: PAW IROHA
runners.comment: Was out of placings last time when sixth (23.16) at Warrnambool in a Bottom Up - Maiden. Will jump from box 5 for the first time. With a clean break looks hard to beat.

runners.name: FIT OF RAGE
runners.comment: Last start finished fifth in a Maiden on July 27 over 390m at this track behind True Agent, beaten 10 lengths (23.06). Will need to improve to feature.

runners.name: INDIANA ICON
runners.comment: Most recent effort finished 5th on July 16 over 390m at this track behind Doongalla Shazia beaten 4.5 lengths (23.27) in a Rank Limit - Restricted Win. Racing well and has to be included.

runners.name: FREE FREDA
runners.comment: Suited by inside box. Last start finished sixth on July 24 over 300m at Healesville behind Smart Roscoe, beaten 15 lengths (17.87) in a Maiden. Not far away last start. Right in the mix again.

ref.race_name: THANKS TO OUR TRACK CURATORS PBD

G:CBG:3:2026-07-30.comment: 2. TINY TEENY showed little early speed at her last couple, the latest finishing sixth (19.43) in a Class 2/3 at Manukau. Does down grade in class today and has claims if she runs up to expectations. 8. PORTLAND SASHA was strongly fancied last time but finished second (19.23), beaten half a length. Consistent performer from this draw with a win and five minor placings to her credit. Can measure up. 5. KIND OF MAGIC has been hard to follow lately, running fourth (26.57) last time but prior to that ran very well when placed at this track. Well placed here and should do much better. Tricky draw but with the drop in trip should be finishing the race off strong. 7. NOT QUITE WHITE is in the mix after placing at a big quote last time out.

runners.name: NOT QUITE WHITE
runners.comment: Finished second last start (19.43) at big odds over 318m at Manukau. Drawn wide. Has claims if at her best.

runners.name: PORTLAND SASHA
runners.comment: Hit the frame latest (19.23) when second at Manukau in a Class 1. Has one success and five minors from 10 starts from box 8. Key chance and should go close.

runners.name: KIND OF MAGIC
runners.comment: Missed the frame last time but finished in the minors at big odds two back when third (26.94) over 457m at this track. Meets a slightly easier field today.

runners.name: TINY TEENY
runners.comment: Didn't make the placings last time at Manukau (19.43) in a Class 2/3, finishing a 8 length sixth. Goes very well from the draw boasting two victories and nine places from 21 starts. Hard to beat with even luck.

runners.name: TINY KIWI
runners.comment: Has not shown much in recent runs. Could only manage fourth last time out over 318m at Manukau. Prepared to risk.

runners.name: OPAWA JENNY
runners.comment: Came from wide draw and finished 5th over 527m at Manukau beaten 6 lengths (32.13) behind Opawa Selena in a Class 1/2 on July 26. Happy to risk this time.

runners.name: CHANCE TO SHINE
runners.comment: Didn't make the placings last time at Manukau (19.99) in a Class 1, finishing a 11 length seventh. Yet to win but has placed seven times from this draw. Looks tested.

R:OTK:3:2026-07-30.comment: 5. GREAT ESCAPE capped off some solid form with a well deserved win at Waverley 3 weeks ago. She has been patiently handled, and should continue to progress through the grades, especially while the tracks are wet. 4. AMAZING SON resumed with a narrowly beaten second fresh up at Woodville, and then bolted home by 4 lengths at Woodville 2 weeks ago over 1200m. The extra 200m is ideal, and he can take the next step immediately. 2. ROCKING can make the most of the pole position, and she is a top 4 hope. 7. CHARM ZAFARM will have no fitness concerns now, and she can spice some combos with a peak effort in this.

runners.name: AMAZING SON
runners.comment: Third-up today and won third-up previously. Resuming 2nd of 13 at Woodville on June 19 over 1200m, on a wet track; head behind Brigit carrying 58kg at $7.90. Second-up favourite; scored a big 4 len win at Hawera July 11 over 1200m in the wet defeating Brady carrying 58.5kg at $2.90. Solid top-three hope.

runners.name: GREAT ESCAPE
runners.comment: Racing well recently. At the latest run favourite; won by 1.75 len at Waverley July 4 over 1200m on a rain affected track defeating Our Akashinga carrying 58kg at $3.20. The start before that 3rd of 13 at Woodville on June 19 over 1200m, on rain affected going; head behind Brigit with 58kg at $4.60. Leading player again.

runners.name: ROCKING
runners.comment: Returns from a 33-day let-up. Last start favourite; won by 0.9 len at Tauranga June 27 over 1400m in heavy going defeating Transaction carrying 51kg at $3. The start before that 9th of 14 at Te Rapa on June 13 over 1400m, on a slow track; 3 len behind Erin Go Bragh with 55.5kg at $11.30. Expect another forward showing.

runners.name: SHEAF
runners.comment: Resuming after a spell of four-and-a-half months. Finished off last preparation fifth of 7 at Tauherenikau March 22 over 2050m, soft track; 6 len behind Psyclone carrying 54.5kg at $3.60. Previously first up; second last of 13 at Trentham October 26 over 1400m, soft track; 6 len behind Wingman carrying 54.5kg at $49.70. Has claims if presented on song.

runners.name: SOTIRIO
runners.comment: At the latest run 3rd in a small field at Hawera on July 11 over 1400m, on heavy track; 6 len behind He's Lucid carrying 58.5kg at $9.90. Before that ran second last in a small field at Trentham on July 2 over 1200m, in the wet; 4 len behind Farravallo with 54kg at $9. Going well and is one of the genuine hopes.

runners.name: CHARM ZAFARM
runners.comment: Most recently raced behind the speed prior to fading 8th of 12 at New Plymouth Raceway on July 18 over 1600m, on a wet track; 8 len behind Jungle Love carrying 54.5kg at $19.60. The race before that ran last of 9 at Waverley on July 4 over 1400m, slow going 7 len behind Bonnard with 54kg at $36.10. Has ability and is ready to make amends.

runners.name: BRIGIT
runners.comment: Most recently ran second last of 7 at New Plymouth Raceway on July 18 over 1200m, on heavy track; 10 len behind Bella Timing carrying 53kg at $6.30. The race before that ran on strongly from last on the turn and won by a head at Woodville June 19 over 1200m in heavy going defeating Amazing Son with 55kg at $7.80. Hard to go past in this suitable contest.

G:SHE:2:2026-07-30.comment: 7. PAW PEARL is having her first look at this circuit. Comes here after a last start 4th and beaten 10 lengths (22.91) at Warrnambool. Should be very hard to beat this time. 1. FLOURISH was below best at his last couple, the latest finishing fourth at Healesville, but was among the placings at Traralgon three back. Key player on best and worth another try. 3. HAVING A LOOK has mixed form recently, finishing fifth (17.45) in a Maiden at Healesville latest but did run well two back when in the frame. Can hit the frame this time. 5. ONE VISION is worth another chance despite missing the top-three here most recently.

runners.name: PAW PEARL
runners.comment: Was out of placings last time when fourth (22.91) at Warrnambool in a Bottom Up - Maiden. Will jump from box 7 for the first time. Rates a leading player.

runners.name: ONE VISION
runners.comment: Last start finished fifth over 390m at this track, beaten 5.5 lengths (23.13) behind Zenyatta in a Maiden on July 27. Must be included.

runners.name: FLOURISH
runners.comment: Suited by inside box. Latest effort finished 4th on July 15 over 300m at Healesville behind Toro Nero beaten 6 lengths (17.58) in a Bottom Up - Maiden. Thereabouts of late and rates highly this line-up. Expected to be in the finish.

runners.name: HAVING A LOOK
runners.comment: Yet to break through after 47 starts, the most recent result a fifth (17.45) over 300m at Healesville. Should prove hard to beat.

runners.name: WYONG ODHRAN
runners.comment: Lines up from box 8 for the first time after finishing a 6 length sixth at Ballarat (26.04) in a Maiden. Looks a place chance at best.

runners.name: MASK OF ZORRO
runners.comment: Latest effort finished 7th in a T3 RSTW on July 23 over 450m at this track behind Fred's Fast beaten 8 lengths (26.38). Leading chance on best form.

runners.name: STILL THE SAME
runners.comment: Last start finished fourth in a Bottom Up - Maiden on July 22 over 425m at Bendigo behind Potato Cakes, beaten 13 lengths (25.09). Hard to entertain this time.

runners.name: MAXIMUM RENAE
runners.comment: Latest effort finished 7th in a Maiden on July 25 over 390m at Ballarat behind Just An Assassin beaten 23 lengths (24.06). Not far away last start. Right in the mix again.

ref.race_name: GRNZ STAFF WE WALK TOGETHER AS ONE PBD

G:CBG:4:2026-07-30.comment: 4. ENTITLED ONE was prominent early from the tricky draw and stalked the lead before levelling up to score (18.83) at Manukau in a SPECA over 318m. The form from her last run stacks up well. Has had a solo trial (21.36) on this track over 375m. Great chance again. 7. RIVERMAN RICHARD recorded a 7 length win (19.03) in a SPECA last time at Manukau. Has two wins already from this draw. Can feature in the finish. 2. PEACH COBBLER looks close to win after hitting the frame last run (19.54) at Manukau in a SPECA. Has first look at box 2 this time. Winning chance. 3. FRUIT PARTY is a last-start placegetter who will have admirers.

runners.name: RIVERMAN RICHARD
runners.comment: Consistent performer who is new here. Nice win last start comfortably by 7 lengths at Manukau (19.03) beating Peach Cobbler in a SPECA on July 26. Can make it back to back wins.

runners.name: PEACH COBBLER
runners.comment: Finished second last start (19.54) over 318m at Manukau. Has a low draw. Must be included.

runners.name: ENTITLED ONE
runners.comment: Won again in another strong performance after running them ragged to make it two on the trot at Manukau over 318m (18.83). Is two from two and and looks a key chance again if runs up to latest.

runners.name: FRUIT PARTY
runners.comment: Has been in the minor money the last two runs, the latest at big odds finishing third (26.46) at this track. Has a low draw. Definite contender.

runners.name: ORDER FOR BRAX
runners.comment: Last start finished seventh in a Class 1/2 on July 23 over 457m at this track behind Tin Tin Bust, beaten 20 lengths (27.22). Not keen.

runners.name: LOOKING FOR HOPE
runners.comment: Modest effort last time out when fourth over 318m at Manukau. Hard to recommend this time.

runners.name: GIZMO'S GADGET
runners.comment: Backs up after finishing 5th on July 26 over 318m at Manukau in a SPECA. Others preferred on this occasion.

G:SHE:3:2026-07-30.comment: 8. CREATIVITY was game in defeat with a narrow loss in last time, when a long neck second behind Heaven On Earth in 22.84 and posting a new PB this course and distance. Smart run latest and looks a key chance here. 6. KRAKEN ZACK is yet to break through in seven starts but has run a number of placings. Returns to favourable course after finishing sixth (25.15) at Bendigo latest. Comes through a solid form race last start. Bold showing expected. 1. STIDHAM TEXAS out of the money last few starts but gets his best chance from the cherry. Last time finished 5th in a Maiden on July 13 over 450m at this track behind Vicky's Fury beaten 6 lengths (26.38). Form from his last run is proving very strong. Better than last start and can bounce back. 2. PATS FOR RUBY looks a chance coming off a ten weeks layoff.

runners.name: MISTAKENLY
runners.comment: Latest effort finished last in a Maiden on July 2 over 390m at this track behind Lil Cockatoo beaten 7 lengths (23.27). Ignore last start. Has ability and can feature in the finish.

runners.name: STIDHAM TEXAS
runners.comment: Latest effort finished 5th in a Maiden on July 13 over 450m at this track behind Vicky's Fury beaten 6 lengths (26.38). Strong form emerging from the that last run. Leading chance.

runners.name: TWILIGHT DIGGER
runners.comment: Most recent effort finished last in a Maiden on July 23 over 390m at this track behind Heaven On Earth beaten 8 lengths (23.38). Can bounce back. One of the main chances.

runners.name: KRAKEN ZACK
runners.comment: Yet to break through after seven starts, the most recent result a sixth (25.15) over 425m at Bendigo. Returns to a favoured course. Looks well placed here.

runners.name: CREATIVITY
runners.comment: Has raced three times and is overdue for a win, the latest offering a second (22.84) over 390m at this track. Looks well placed here.

runners.name: PATS FOR RUBY
runners.comment: Finished off last campaign with a eighth (25.47) in a Rank Limit - Maiden at Bendigo ten weeks ago. Looks a key runner while fresh.

runners.name: SIMPLY A THIEF
runners.comment: First two runs have been average, the latest a seventh over 390m at this track. Looks up against it this time.

runners.name: GOLDEN REDEEMER
runners.comment: Modest effort last time out when fourth over 390m at this track. This will test.

ref.race_name: OWNERS TRAINERS UNITED TO THE END PBD

G:CBG:5:2026-07-30.comment: 4. PAPA KIWI turned in a better run last time to find a minor placing (31.55) at Manukau behind Portland Magnum in a Class 3/4. Has the pace to be prominent. Gets a slight down grade today and good form should continue. 7. SENDING ME turned in a solid run last start over 318m at Manukau finishing 4th and beaten only 4 lengths (19.42). Has placed a couple of times at this track. Can figure in the finish. 6. AU FAIT has been beaten for early speed lately, last time finishing sixth (19.60) in a Class 2/3 at Manukau. Solid record here winning two races. Will give the top chances plenty to think about. 3. WHO'S A SAINT made it two minor placings on the trot when beaten second (21.57) in a Class 3 at this track last time out.

runners.name: SENDING ME
runners.comment: Missed the frame last start when a 4 length fourth (19.42) at Manukau. Previous form sound including a win three back at Manukau. Well placed here and looks a leading contender.

runners.name: PAPA KIWI

G:CBG:6:2026-07-30.comment: 3. OPAWA VANESSA has been beaten for early speed lately, last time finishing fourth (19.24) in a Class 2/3 at Manukau. Has a good record at this journey. Consistent performer from this draw with a win and two minor placings to her credit. Comes to a veteran race today and can bounce back. 2. DYNAMIC KIWI was strongly fancied latest and proved too good with a head win at Manukau in a handy 19.26. Fair draw can see a good run and has the ability and in winning form. Has very reliable box manners and a bold showing expected again. 8. SWEET wasn't far away at the finish when 5th and beaten only 3.5 lengths (19.44) at Manukau. Won nicely from this draw two back at this track. One of the better hopes. 7. HUNTER HONEY pinged the lids and wasn’t headed last time. Big chance again.

runners.name: HUNTER PEARL
runners.comment: Backs up after finishing 5th on July 26 over 318m at Manukau in a Class 2. Happy enough to avoid.

runners.name: SWEET
runners.comment: Was a little disappointing last start, fading in the run home at Manukau over 318m. The start prior was at her best with a 4 length win over 375m at this track. Capable of taking this out.

runners.name: OPAWA VANESSA
runners.comment: Didn't make the placings last time at Manukau (19.24) in a Class 2/3, finishing a 6 length fourth. Goes well out of this box with a win and two minors. Expected to go close.

runners.name: DYNAMITE BOY
runners.comment: Last start finished seventh over 318m at Manukau, beaten 8 lengths (19.55) behind Val Jewel in a Class 2 on July 26. Better for the run but looks tested in this field.

runners.name: DYNAMIC KIWI
runners.comment: Good performance to win by a head at Manukau over 318m (19.26) beating Thrilling Lad in SPECA on July 26. Expected to go well again.

runners.name: KOOKABURRA BOB
runners.comment: Has finished fifth at his last couple of starts, most recently at this track over 457m. Slow starts make it difficult for him to feature. Others preferred.

runners.name: HUNTER HONEY
runners.comment: Solid performance to post a big 4 lengths win at Manukau over 318m (19.16) beating Not Quite White in Class 1 on July 26. Must be a winning chance again.

G:QST:2:2026-07-30.comment: 8. KELSEY'S BEACH ran above expectations last time to win her first race by 1.75 lengths at this track over 350m (19.29). Boxed wide here. Can continue the winning form. 1. TORPEY HAYZE led throughout to score two back then drifted back and missed the frame latest finishing a 4.5 lengths 4th at this track (19.50). Key runner who gets her chance to atone. 4. HAYMET HARRY turned in a plain performance last time when seventh at this track over 300m behind Farmor Defiant (17.72) in a Grade 6. Has ability and is one of the better chances. 6. WINNING EDITION placed last time and is worth some thought.

runners.name: KELSEY'S BEACH
runners.comment: Solid performance to win by 1.75 lengths at this track over 350m (19.29) beating Pannonia in Maiden on July 23. Comes through a good form race. Looks a top chance.

runners.name: TORPEY HAYZE
runners.comment: Was out of placings last time when fourth (19.50) at this track in a Grade 6. Will jump from box 1 for the first time. Rates a leading player.

runners.name: CRISIS AVERTED
runners.comment: Finished third last start (20.21) at big odds over 366m at Capalaba. Jumps from the outside. Looks tested in this line-up.

runners.name: WINNING EDITION
runners.comment: Good effort last time when third (17.16) over 300m at this track. One of the better hopes.

runners.name: VERY SHREWD
runners.comment: Has not shown much in recent runs. Could only manage sixth last time out over 520m at Q Parklands. Likely to struggle this time.

runners.name: SMASHING DOUBLE
runners.comment: Has been out of the money of late. Could only manage fourth last time out over 300m at this track. Likely to struggle this time.

runners.name: HAYMET HARRY
runners.comment: Was out of placings last time (17.72) at this track in a Grade 6, finishing seventh and beaten 8 lengths. Has two placings from four starts from the draw. Among the main chances.

Has the early speed to land on the pace and can stick on. Yet to win out of this box but has been in the placings five times from nine starts. Winning claims. 7. LIKE A BLAZE has been mixing form lately, hitting the frame two back before finishing seventh (24.98) at Bendigo in a Bottom Up - Grade 5. Well placed here and can atone this time. 1. TIPSY TILLY was out of the placings last time when eighth at Bendigo (24.93) but scored five back at Bendigo (24.25). Has a good record here at this journey. Expected to give a good account. 2. MOTIVATE is worth consideration.

runners.name: MOTIVATE
runners.comment: Has finished sixth at his last couple of starts, most recently at Warrnambool over 450m. Capable of taking this out.

runners.name: TIPSY TILLY
runners.comment: Last start finished last on July 22 over 425m at Bendigo behind Husky Sara Lee beaten 7 lengths (24.93) in a Bottom Up - Grade 5. Has performed below expectations at her last couple but is capable of far better.

runners.name: LIKE A BLAZE
runners.comment: Last start finished last on July 22 over 425m at Bendigo behind Goof Ball beaten 4 lengths (24.98) in a Bottom Up - Grade 5. More than capable and well placed to find her best form.

runners.name: SPRING QUEUE
runners.comment: Last start finished seventh on July 27 over 350m at Traralgon behind Angry Ellie, beaten 8 lengths (20.95) in a Rank Limit - Grade 5. Needs to find a bit more to test these.

runners.name: ZIPPING GLINDA
runners.comment: Good effort at double-figure odds last time when second (20.46) over 350m at Traralgon. Drawn close to the inside. Must be included.

runners.name: BREE CABANG
runners.comment: In the money last time at this track (22.95) in a Grade 5, finishing a 5 length third. Still a maiden from the draw but has placed five times. Looks suited and should go close.

runners.name: NOTORIOUS BLAZE
runners.comment: Finished third at big odds last time (24.57) over 425m at Bendigo. Jumps from a wide draw. Deserves respect.

runners.name: TAT BUDDY
runners.comment: Needs to do more than recent efforts, the latest a seventh over 390m at this track. Looks up against it this time.
